ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the request is a simple coding task (generate a shuffled list of numbers), which is fundamentally a transactional/extraction-style job. Both models report identical preference (50) for neutral transactional requests, so preference is a wash there. The deciding factor was raw capability—Dunlin leads on every public benchmark (e.g., MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.1, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 80.9) and internal evals. The warm, friendly tone of the message is the one thing that nominally favors Plover (which prefers warm exchanges), but the documentation explicitly states task preferences don't translate into output-quality differences. So I weighted capability over preference and chose Dunlin.
